# AttachmentRelationship

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The relationship an embedded file has to the PDF that carries it, written as the `/AFRelationship` entry of the file's `/Filespec` dictionary (PDF 2.0 §7.11.3, ISO 19005-3 for PDF/A-3). Associated files are the mechanism e-invoicing standards (ZUGFeRD / Factur-X) use to attach the source XML alongside the rendered invoice.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Unspecified`: The relationship is not known or does not fit the other categories. Emitted as `/Unspecified`. Default.
- `Source`: The file is the source from which the PDF's visible content was derived (e.g. the XML invoice a ZUGFeRD PDF renders). `/Source`.
- `Data`: The file holds data used to generate the visible content. `/Data`. The relationship Factur-X uses for its invoice XML.
- `Alternative`: The file is an alternative (e.g. a different format) representation of the PDF's content. `/Alternative`.
- `Supplement`: The file supplements the PDF's content with additional material. `/Supplement`.
- `EncryptedPayload`: The file is an encrypted payload; the PDF is a wrapper carrying it. `/EncryptedPayload`.
- `FormData`: The file contains data associated with an AcroForm. `/FormData`.
- `Schema`: The file is a schema definition for other associated files. `/Schema`.
